trans-unit.source: I wonder what made Demeter move to that island?
trans-unit.target: I wonder what made Demeter move to that island?

trans-unit.source: Might have something to do with his own magic research...
trans-unit.target: Might have something to do with his own magic research...

trans-unit.source: At least we know where he is. Let's chase him by ship.
trans-unit.target: At least we know where he is. Let's chase him by ship.

trans-unit.source: Yeah, you got it. There's no other way.
trans-unit.target: Yeah, you got it. There's no other way.

trans-unit.source: Then let's hurry to the port!
trans-unit.target: Then let's hurry to the port!

trans-unit.source: The longer Demeter's free, the more likely he'll repeat his crimes.
trans-unit.target: The longer Demeter's free, the more likely he'll repeat his crimes.
